segment_summary: নদীর আরোপিত কাঠামো এবং অর্থনৈতিক চাপ সত্ত্বেও, তার ভেতরের মানবিক প্রবাহ অক্ষুণ্ণ থাকে।

segment_enrichment.angle: Framing the realization not as victory over capitalism, but as acceptance of the eternal human need for unmeasured grace within it.
segment_enrichment.story_option: Setting: Inside his boat during a complete, oppressive darkness where only starlight penetrates. Desire: To recall the specific texture of the finest Bhatiyali melody from memory. Obstacle: The silence is too absolute, swallowing all sound except water lapping.
segment_enrichment.subject_rotation: Examining the physical sensation of philosophical weight—how does unquantifiable debt feel in the body?
segment_enrichment.sensory_detail: The granular feeling of fine, damp silt sticking between the calloused pads of his feet at dawn.
segment_enrichment.research_question: How can I depict the precise auditory difference between an oar cutting through placid water versus struggling against muddy resistance?
segment_enrichment.structural_variant: An oscillating rhythm: highly lyrical lines detailing the internal state punctuated by stark, monosyllabic phrases describing physical reality.
segment_enrichment.variety_note: Unlike previous chapters that focused on external pressures (bridges, debt), this chapter centers entirely on internal philosophical synthesis—the integration of accepted reality into a lasting personal conviction.
